title: Navigate and render core public pages end-to-end
description: Verifies a visitor can open each core public route and the page content renders successfully without authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the About page
Click the link to view the Services page
Click the link to view the Portfolio page
Click the link to view the Blog page
Click the link to view the Careers page
Click the link to view the Contact page
Verify each visited page shows its primary page content section (not a blank or broken layout)

title: Language choice persists from home to contact page
description: After switching to Indonesian on the landing page, user navigates to the contact page and still sees Indonesian content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Switch language to Indonesian
Click the link to open the contact page
Verify the contact page content is displayed in Indonesian

title: Submit consultation request successfully with a gmail address
description: Verifies a lead can submit the consultation request with a valid @gmail.com address and is presented the Gmail compose follow-up path.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Fill "Test Lead" into the full name field
Fill "testlead.sagara.qa@gmail.com" into the email field
Select a service type from the dropdown
Fill "Need a consultation for a small web project; please advise next steps." into the project details field
Submit the consultation request form
Verify a Gmail compose interface opens with pre-filled follow-up content

title: Open chatbot and complete ask-response loop
description: Verifies a visitor can open the AI chatbot, send a question, and see a response rendered in the chat panel.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the floating AI chatbot button
Fill "What services do you offer for web development?" into the chat message input
Send the chat message
Verify a chatbot response message appears in the chat panel

title: Switch landing page language to Indonesian
description: User can switch the landing page language to Indonesian and sees the page content update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Switch language to Indonesian
Verify the landing page content is displayed in Indonesian

title: Use header/footer navigation to reach key destinations
description: Verifies a visitor can use site navigation to move between pages and always reach the intended destination.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the footer navigation area
Click the footer link to view the Services page
Click the header link to view the Portfolio page
Click the header link to view the Blog page
Click the header link to view the Home page
Verify the user lands on the landing page and the hero section is displayed

title: Recover from non-gmail validation by correcting to gmail and submitting
description: Verifies a lead can correct a non-@gmail.com email to a valid @gmail.com and then successfully submit the consultation request.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Fill "Test Lead" into the full name field
Fill "testlead@company.com" into the email field
Select a service type from the dropdown
Fill "Initial invalid email; then corrected." into the project details field
Submit the consultation request form
Fill "testlead.sagara.qa@gmail.com" into the email field
Submit the consultation request form
Verify a Gmail compose interface opens with pre-filled follow-up content

title: Browse portfolio highlights and reach consultation CTA
description: Verifies a prospective client can browse portfolio items and follow a call-to-action path to start a consultation request.

steps.description: Navigate to /portfolio.html
Scroll through the portfolio highlights
Click the call-to-action to contact the company about a project
Verify the consultation request form is displayed

title: Subscribe to newsletter from landing page
description: User can enter an email address on the landing page and submit the newsletter form to see a subscription confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the newsletter subscription section
Fill test.user+sagara.newsletter@gmail.com into the newsletter email field
Submit the newsletter subscription
Verify a subscription confirmation is visible

title: Browse services overview content
description: Verifies a reader can open the services page and see service categories with descriptions.

steps.description: Navigate to /services.html
Scroll through the services list
Verify multiple service categories are displayed with short descriptions

title: Block consultation submit when email is not gmail
description: Verifies a lead using a non-@gmail.com address is prevented from submitting and sees a client-side validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Fill "Test Lead" into the full name field
Fill "testlead@company.com" into the email field
Select a service type from the dropdown
Fill "Project details for validation test." into the project details field
Submit the consultation request form
Verify an email validation error is visible and submission is blocked

title: Language persists after refresh on contact page
description: After choosing Indonesian, refreshing the contact page preserves the chosen language and keeps content in Indonesian.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Switch language to Indonesian
Press F5
Verify the contact page content is displayed in Indonesian

title: Chatbot supports multi-turn conversation
description: Verifies a visitor can send a second message after receiving a response and see an additional response appended in the chat panel.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the floating AI chatbot button
Fill "Tell me about your services." into the chat message input
Send the chat message
Wait for the chatbot response to appear
Fill "How do I request a consultation?" into the chat message input
Send the chat message
Verify the chat panel shows an additional chatbot response after the second message

title: Switch contact page language back to English
description: User can switch language to English on the contact page and sees the contact page content update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact.html
Switch language to Indonesian
Switch language to English
Verify the contact page content is displayed in English

title: Browse portfolio and proceed to contact from portfolio
description: User can browse the portfolio page and follow a contact/consultation path that takes them to the contact page.

steps.description: Navigate to /portfolio.html
Scroll through the featured projects section
Open a project details or summary view if available
Click a contact or consultation call-to-action from the portfolio page
Verify the user lands on the contact page

title: Browse careers page and view job listings
description: A job seeker can open the careers page and see job listings rendered along with culture/recruitment information.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view careers
Scroll through the careers page content
Verify job listings are displayed
Verify team culture or recruitment information is displayed

title: Chatbot input clears after sending a message
description: Verifies that after a visitor sends a chatbot message, the input field is cleared for the next message.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the floating AI chatbot button
Fill "Hello" into the chat message input
Send the chat message
Verify the chat message input is empty

title: Follow application instructions from a job listing
description: A job seeker can open a listing and access the application instructions or next-step contact method from the careers page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view careers
Click into a job listing details section
Click the application instructions or next-steps link
Verify application instructions are visible

title: Chatbot can be opened and closed without losing page context
description: Verifies a visitor can open and close the chatbot panel and continue viewing the landing page content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the floating AI chatbot button
Click the control to close the chatbot panel
Verify the landing page primary content remains visible and usable after closing the chatbot

title: Browse blog listing content
description: Verifies a visitor can open the blog page and see a list of available posts or blog content blocks.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog.html
Scroll through the blog content area
Verify a blog listing or blog content sections are displayed

title: Portfolio page renders project listings
description: User can open the portfolio page and see a list or grid of showcased projects to evaluate past work.

steps.description: Navigate to /portfolio.html
Verify showcased projects are displayed

title: Use careers page call-to-action to start contacting the company
description: A job seeker can use a careers call-to-action to navigate toward contacting the company for applications or inquiries.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view careers
Scroll to the careers next-steps or call-to-action section
Click the contact call-to-action
Verify the user lands on the contact page

title: Browse about page company overview
description: Verifies a visitor can open the about page and view company overview and impact content.

steps.description: Navigate to /about.html
Scroll through the company overview section
Verify company overview and impact content is displayed

title: Newsletter blocks malformed email
description: User cannot submit the newsletter form with an invalid email format and is shown an input validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the newsletter subscription section
Fill not-an-email into the newsletter email field
Submit the newsletter subscription
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Careers page renders correctly in a narrow mobile viewport
description: A job seeker can view careers content in a narrow viewport and still access job listings and instructions without content disappearing.

steps.description: Navigate to /careers.html
Resize the browser to a narrow mobile width
Scroll through the careers page
Verify job listings are displayed
Verify application instructions or next steps are displayed

title: Careers page internal navigation enables scanning multiple roles
description: A job seeker can move between multiple job listings on the careers page to compare roles.

steps.description: Navigate to /careers.html
Scroll to the job listings section
Click to view one job listing details section
Click to view a different job listing details section
Verify details for the second job listing are displayed

title: Portfolio project summaries are readable without expanding content
description: User can read a concise project summary/outcomes on the portfolio page without requiring unsupported interactions.

steps.description: Navigate to /portfolio.html
Scroll to a project card or project summary section
Verify at least one project summary with outcomes is visible

title: Newsletter prevents double submit
description: User cannot accidentally submit the newsletter form multiple times rapidly and the UI prevents duplicate submission while processing.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the newsletter subscription section
Fill test.user+sagara.rapid@gmail.com into the newsletter email field
Submit the newsletter subscription
Immediately submit the newsletter subscription again
Verify only one subscription confirmation is visible
